canonical_project: Cosmo Park Kada / Asa GK Google-related data center site
notes: Reports based on Wakayama Prefecture say about 37 ha at Cosmo Park Kada in Wakayama City was to be sold for 5.94 billion yen to Asa GK, a Google-related company, for a data center; prefecture had also run a FY2022 data center attraction basic survey. Project details and capacity are undisclosed.
